symptom: A synthetic no-op Array.prototype.some allows nonfinite or nonnumeric RESULT metrics and enumerable symbol-key metric properties through the v0.1 validator. NaN/Infinity serialize as null, while symbol-key evidence is silently omitted. No real evaluation data or scoring authority was involved.
lesson: Strict record admission and canonical digesting must not delegate finite metric checks or own-key shape checks to mutable Array.prototype.some/every; an overridden method can admit evidence that JSON serialization changes or omits.
guardrail: Validate every metric and every own property descriptor with indexed loops; reject symbol keys, nonfinite and nonnumber values before hashing or append. Keep a synthetic no-op Array.some regression and do not infer scoring authorization.
